Lesson 9 · Business route

Audit the adjusted comparison

How much did a selected program help its eligible population?

What the data show

The observed treated–control gap is 8.57 units. Regression standardization estimates an average effect of 3.86 units after using measured pre-program characteristics.

What would you decide?

State the target population, check that comparable treated and untreated units exist, and test whether unmeasured selection could change the recommendation.

Pause and explain

Which facilities should the director examine before expanding coaching?

Compare your reasoning

Examine facility types with few comparable uncoached sites, then decide where a planned pilot would be more informative than another adjustment.

Check your judgment

Reveal the case’s known answer

The case’s average coaching effect is 3.87 units. Compare that with the adjusted estimate when judging the proposed network-wide rollout.

Continue at your own depth

Read the guided lesson

The guided lesson follows this business decision through the practical problem, evidence and next action. The technical appendix has the generation rules, derivations and all 28 original teaching stops.
